answer.reason: The Electric utilities row in Table 1 is the sector subtotal below the broader All energy sources total; of the two options, 46,637,698 MWh is the lower sector subtotal, so it is the value listed for Electric utilities.

A. 46,637,698 megawatthours
B. 47,431,447 megawatthours

Source citation: Oklahoma Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/oklahoma/index.php)
